rounds.text: {"operations": [{"op": "invertEdge", "consumer": "org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive", "impl": "org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive.moment.VectorialCovariance"}], "rationale": "Inverting the sole dependency from org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive to org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive.moment via VectorialCovariance removes the only edge in that direction, leaving only moment-to-descriptive dependencies and breaking the cycle."}

{"operations": [{"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive.MultivariateSummaryStatistics", "to": "org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive.moment"}], "rationale": "Moving MultivariateSummaryStatistics into the moment package makes the sole descriptive-to-moment dependency intra-package, so only moment-to-descriptive dependencies remain and the cycle is broken."}
